verdict: Avery Dennison's sales rose 5% to $2.33B, led by its Materials Group, and net income rose 2% to $170M (EPS $2.24, or $2.42 adjusted) despite softer apparel-label demand.

kpis.label: Materials Group sales
kpis.note: The labels and films core is growing again

segments.name: Materials Group
segments.note: Label and graphics films — the paper-and-film materials that become product labels. High-value categories (including RFID-ready materials) grew mid-single digits.

segments.name: Solutions Group
segments.note: RFID tags and identification solutions for apparel and other industries; apparel categories grew, but the overall segment dipped on currency and mix.

opex.name: Marketing, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling, marketing and running the company.

opex.name: Other expense, net
opex.note: Smaller operating items, including restructuring-related costs.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $36M, partly offset by $4M of other non-operating income (pension and currency items).

takeaways.title: Sales rose to $2.33B
takeaways.text: Organic growth of 3.7% plus currency gains; the Materials Group did the heavy lifting with sales up 8.5%.

takeaways.title: Adjusted EPS of $2.42
takeaways.text: Up 2% — slower than sales, reflecting margin pressure in Materials (adjusted margin down 110 basis points) as growth categories carry start-up costs.

takeaways.title: Full-year EPS guidance set
takeaways.text: Reported EPS guidance for 2026 is $9.45–$9.59, or $10.10–$10.24 adjusted.
